name: Origin Factory Store
description: Got 2 of these Core Polos today! Black and battleship in size medium! They have a nice feel similar to Ogio golf polos. The fit is what’s to be expected out of a nice polo, true to size but slightly more fitted. I have more medium-sized Origin Core t-shirts than I can count and they definitely fit much looser than the Core polo. This is fine for me because I don’t like tucking in a super loose shirt and having muffin top going on. I recommend these because they’re both aesthetically pleasing and comfortable. Been buying Origin gear since 2020 and not a regret with this Core polo.
